description: This file defines a PHP class GitterIntegration that implements functionality to post activity messages to Gitter rooms using the Guzzle HTTP client. It includes methods for configuration handling, providing name and description, and publishing activity messages.

classes.name: GitterIntegration
classes.description: A class to integrate with Gitter for posting activity messages

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with application configuration

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the integration

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the integration

methods.name: getExternalUrl
methods.description: Returns the external URL of Gitter

methods.name: publishActivity
methods.description: Publishes an activity message to a Gitter room based on the provided action

methods.name: hasConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the Gitter integration is properly configured

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration for the Gitter integration
